whoTheyAre.summary: The live source identifies South Azeri in Iran and ties the record to South Azerbaijani (azb). Glottolog independently identifies the language, while scholarship on writing, language policy and collective identity shows that Iranian Azerbaijani identity and public language use have developed through specific historical and institutional contexts.

claims.text: The live PeopleGroups.org record PG024136 reports PEID 24136, display name South Azeri, country Iran and primary language Azerbaijani, South (azb).
Glottolog identifies South Azerbaijani with glottocode sout2697 and ISO 639-3 code azb.

Recent scholarship on Azeri Turkish writing in Iran and historical research on Azerbaijani collective identity both show that language use and collective identity have been shaped by changing institutional and historical conditions rather than one timeless political identity.
claims.interpretationNote: This synthesis is deliberately non-predictive: it does not infer separatist, nationalist or state-loyalist views from South Azeri identity.
